# Furniture fit (generated by tools/fit_furniture.py)

Rule from the family: **double (shared queen bed) where there is enough space, otherwise single.** Room and toilet geometry is exactly as DRAWN.
Furniture sizes are from the brief, taken as the Wakefit models from the PG chat: single bed 2.05×0.95, queen 2.05×1.58, 3-door sliding wardrobe 1.20 wide (0.55 deep, fits the drawn grey strips), wall desk 0.90×0.45, standard desk 1.16×0.57. These were not independently verified against Wakefit's catalogue, so please send the exact model links if they differ.

A layout passes only if every item is inside the room and clear of walls, the other items, every door swing and every clearance zone. It also needs a **0.55 m walking path** (ASSUMED) from the room door to every bed side, the wardrobe front, the desk chair zone, and the toilet or terrace door.
